get.description:
A raster image is served inline as its type, text other than HTML inline as plain text; anything else, an SVG and HTML among it, as a download of `application/octet-stream`, whatever type it was stored with. The type is never sniffed.

get.description:
Exchanges authorization code for tokens and sets access token cookie.

Query Parameters:     code: Authorization code from OIDC provider     state: CSRF token from OIDC provider

Returns:     302: Redirect to original redirect URL with access token cookie set     400: Invalid or missing callback parameters     401: Token exchange failed
get.summary: Handle OIDC callback after user authorization.

get.description:
Generates authorization URL and redirects to OIDC provider. PKCE state is encrypted into the OAuth state parameter. The ``redirect_uri`` is the callback on the origin the request came in on, so the app signs in on every hostname it is served on (each one registered at the IdP).

Query Parameters:     redirect: Path to redirect to after successful login (required)

Returns:     302: Redirect to OIDC provider authorization endpoint     400: Missing or invalid redirect parameter
get.summary: Initiate OIDC login flow with PKCE.

get.description:
Clears access token cookie and redirects to OIDC provider's logout endpoint to terminate the session at the IdP level.

Query Parameters:     redirect: Path to redirect to after logout (default: /)

Returns:     302: Redirect to OIDC logout endpoint (or direct redirect if OIDC disabled)     400: Invalid redirect parameter
get.summary: Log out current user.

get.description:
This endpoint is @public, so the request hook resolves the caller (refreshing an expired access token) without answering 401 itself, and the handler answers 401 when no one is signed in. A caller with none of the app's roles gets 403 from the hook. With OIDC disabled, the caller is the local admin.

Returns:     200: User information     401: No valid token provided or token invalid     403: User authenticated but has none of the app's roles
get.summary: Get current authenticated user information.

No `id:` field: the sidecar's hashes are its cursor. Ends on shutdown, and when the stream falls too far behind. Refused with 401, 403 or 426, and answered 502, as every sync call is.

put.description:
Headers: `X-Pilot-Base-Hash`, the hash the sidecar last synced for the path, or `none`; `X-Pilot-Session`, the Session that held the write lock of the path's project folder as the sidecar read the file, left out when none held it: the save is that Session's when it is a brain session of the path's project, and no Session's otherwise. The body is the file's bytes, at most `SYNC_PUT_MAX_BYTES`.

Answers 204 when the file needs no change, 200 with the bytes it must now hold when it does; either with `X-Pilot-Hash`, the hash the file holds once answered, and `X-Pilot-Faults`, the count of Save Errors the save raised on the path, and `X-Pilot-Stale: true` when the base hash was not the path's tree hash. 404 for a path of no syncing project.

post.description: Returns:     201: The item, a prose item's file, a work item's state as the gate         left it, and the call's effect line     400: The body is not an item in `timeline.json`'s shape     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a chat's or a job's, or has no turn         running     404: An attachment, the plan's task, a claim's item or a source's         environment is not the session's project's or the controller's,         or a claim's document has no such block     409: A wait, a field the kind does not take or one it needs missing,         a text with faults, material that cannot be copied, a claim that         is not an open action of a registered document, or a start the         project refuses: the reason     502: The controller did not answer, or refused for a reason of its own
post.summary: `add_item(item)` (F86.1, F86.6, F36.5): a prose item minted with its file, or a work item started on add, named for the claimed actions it does (F21.6), with the attachments it carries.

post.description: Returns:     200: The call's effect line     400: The body is not an item's id, a mark and an optional handle     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a chat's or a job's, or has no turn         running     404: The item is not of the session's project, or no person has the         handle     409: Read or Reviewed without a person, or the record refuses the         mark: the reason
post.summary: `mark(item, done | read | reviewed, for?)` (F86.3): Done, Read or Reviewed on an item for the person `for` names, else Pilot's own Done.

post.description: Returns:     200: The call's effect line     400: The body is not an item's id     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a chat's or a job's, or has no turn         running     404: The item is not of the session's project     409: It is no work item, or its session is neither running, starting         nor held: the reason
post.summary: `stop_work(item)` (F86.4): a work item's session stopped by Pilot.

post.description: Returns:     201: The document's blocks its writer is asked about     400: The body is not a block's id and a question     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a job's, or has no turn running     404: The block's item is not of the session's project, or its         document has no such block     409: The question is blank, the item is no registered document or is         done, the block is answered or was asked about already, or the         pass asks nothing, one round per worker turn: the reason
post.summary: `ask_writer(block, question)` (F86.8, D059): the pre-ruling pass's question to a registered document's writer about one of its blocks, the block's id naming its document, recorded with the pass's turn.

post.description: Returns:     201: The attachments, one per file     400: The body is not a path and an optional item id     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a work item's     404: `to` names no item of the session's project     409: A file cannot be copied, nothing attached: the reason     502: The controller did not answer, or refused for a reason of its own
post.summary: `attach_file(path, to?)` (F85.2, F36.1): the file or the folder the worker wrote at `path` in its environment, copied into the record now with its source and hung on the item `to` names, else on the session's own work item.

post.description: Returns:     200: The document the session registered from the path already     201: The document, minted     400: The body is not a path     401: No bearer, or one no session has     403: The bearer's session is not a work item's     409: The file cannot be registered, nothing minted: the reason, the         text's faults each with its line     502: The controller did not answer, or refused for a reason of its own
post.summary: `register_document(path)` (F85.1, ruling D1): the file the worker wrote at `path` in its environment, read and parsed now, registered as a document on its project's timeline, its text read at the end of the turn.
